## PDF page 3

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/Peak%20Poker%20Performance.pdf#page=3)

```text
Dr. Patricia Cardner
Dr. Patricia (Tricia) Cardner provides
peak performance strategy coaching
and consulting to some of today’s
biggest names in poker. She teaches
advanced psychological techniques and
strategies gleaned through her years
of work as a psychology professor and
licensed therapist that show players
how to use psychology to gain an
edge over their competition.
She is the author of Positive Poker
with Jonathan Little and a contributor
to Jonathan Little’s Excelling at No-
Limit Hold’em, as well as a coach at
Red Chip Poker. Dr. Cardner hosts a
regular podcast with Elliot Roe, called
The Mindset Advantage Podcast where
they interview the most elite players
in the game in order to uncover their
mental game secrets for success.
To learn more about how to perform
at your best, visit her at
www.DrTriciaCardner.com


Jonathan Little
Jonathan has won two WPT events
and final tabled two others, earning
him the Season 6 Player of the Year
award. He has total live tournament
earnings in excess of $6 million.
He has cashed 30 times at the WSOP.
He is the author of 10 best-selling
poker books including Excelling at
No-Limit Hold’em. Jonathan is also
a poker coach who frequently posts
free training content at
JonathanLittlePoker.com
```
